$comment: Which raster renders exist for each cover (the case studies), and what each cover shows. Hand-edited: add an aspect here, run `npm run covers:render`, commit the images. scripts/validate-cover-rasters.mjs holds this file, the cover map in case-study-covers.tsx, and the files on disk to each other.

card.use: The card cover slot — the /work grid and the Card showcase. Cards sit in a multi-column grid, so 1600px is roughly 3x a typical card and 2x the widest one.

feature.use: The home page's featured card and the robr0-ds hero. Every study is listed here, not just today's featured one, because the home page features caseStudies[0] — reordering the registry must not leave a study without its render.

wide.use: The two Meta case-study heroes, which call for 16:9 rather than the 16:10 the others use.

/work/augmenta-ai.alt: Augmenta's coordination model viewer, with a routed pipework solution traced in green through a wireframe building model.

/work/embedded-ai-turbotax.alt: A Claude conversation where TurboTax returns a 2025 tax year checklist, with a drop zone for documents and the wage and investment forms already gathered.

/work/intuit-agent-chat.alt: Intuit's assistant open full screen, offering starter prompts about cash flow, bottlenecks and growth above an ask-anything composer.

/work/meta-career-profile.alt: Meta's candidate offer summary, listing role details beside a total compensation figure broken into salary, bonus, equity and sign-on.

/work/meta-offers.alt: Meta's recruiter offer draft, with a candidate's profile and engagement history beside a calculator comparing standard, maximum and proposed compensation.

/work/robr0-ds.alt: This site's playground, with theme controls for action colour, corner radius and typeface down the left of a live chat preview.
